title: Analysis of Large Language Model Decision Making in Hormone Receptor-Positive/Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2-Negative Early Breast Cancer.
authors: Buonaiuto, Roberto; Caltavituro, Aldo; Di Rienzo, Rossana; Grieco, Angela; Mangiacotti, Federica P; Longobardi, Alessandra; Cantile, Vincenza; Molinaro, Vittoria; Pagliuca, Martina; Buono, Giuseppe; De Placido, Pietro; Pietroluongo, Erica; Forestieri, Valeria; Martinelli, Claudia; di Lauro, Vincenzo; Leo, Luigi; D'Aiuto, Massimiliano; Bianchini, Giampaolo; Criscitiello, Carmen; Bianco, Roberto; Del Mastro, Lucia; De Laurentiis, Michelino; Arpino, Grazia; De Angelis, Carmine; Giuliano, Mario
one_liner_zh: 该文评估GPT-4o在HR+/HER2-早期乳腺癌辅助治疗决策中的表现，与临床医生及Oncotype DX结果比较，纯临床决策应用，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: To assess the ability of GPT-4o in adjuvant treatment decision making in hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) early breast cancer by comparing its recommendations with those of clinicians including Oncotype DX data, and to explore its potential as a decision-support tool in routine clinical practice. METHODS: We compared clinician and GPT-4o recommendations in patients tested with Oncotype DX in routine practice at the University of Naples Federico II (n = 607, cohort 1 [C1]) and within the prospective, multicenter PRO BONO study (n = 237, cohort 2 [C2]). Pre- and post-Oncotype DX treatment recommendations were categorized as chemotherapy (CT) + endocrine therapy (ET) or ET alone. Concordance between clinician and GPT-4o recommendations was assessed using agreement rates and Cohen's kappa. The accuracy of Oncotype DX results was evaluated using the AUC metric. RESULTS: The agreement between clinicians and GPT-4o in pretest recommendations was 68% (kappa, 0.381 [95% CI, 0.31 to 0.45], P < .001) in C1 and 70% (0.401 [95% CI, 0.29 to 0.52], P < .001) in C2. Before Oncotype DX, clinicians recommended CT more frequently than GPT-4o for C1 (58% v 38%) and C2 (53% v 43%). Post-test agreement increased to 93% (0.814 [95% CI, 0.76 to 0.87], P < .001) in C1 and 90% (0.741 [95% CI, 0.64 to 0.84], P < .001) in C2. The agreement between pre- and post-Oncotype DX treatment recommendations for clinicians was 56% and 63% versus 68% and 60% for GPT-4o in C1 and C2, respectively. GPT-4o showed higher accuracy in predicting low than high genomic risk in postmenopausal patients (87% v 43% in C1; 85% v 45% in C2, P < .001) and low versus intermediate and high risk in premenopausal patients in both cohorts (P < .001). CONCLUSION: The agreement between clinicians and GPT-4o in pretest recommendations was modest but improved post-test, highlighting the importance of multigene testing and the potential of large language models in clinical decision making.
abstract_zh: 目的：评估GPT-4o在激素受体阳性（HR+）/人表皮生长因子受体2阴性（HER2-）早期乳腺癌辅助治疗决策中的能力，通过将其建议与包括Oncotype DX数据在内的临床医生建议进行比较，并探讨其在常规临床实践中作为决策支持工具的潜力。方法：我们比较了在那不勒斯费德里科二世大学常规实践中接受Oncotype DX检测的患者（n = 607，队列1 [C1]）以及前瞻性多中心PRO BONO研究中的患者（n = 237，队列2 [C2]）的临床医生和GPT-4o建议。Oncotype DX检测前后的治疗建议被分类为化疗（CT）+内分泌治疗（ET）或仅ET。使用一致率和Cohen's kappa评估临床医生与GPT-4o建议之间的一致性。Oncotype DX结果的准确性通过AUC指标评估。结果：在C1中，临床医生与GPT-4o在检测前建议上的一致性为68%（kappa，0.381 [95% CI，0.31至0.45]，P < .001），在C2中为70%（0.401 [95% CI，0.29至0.52]，P < .001）。在Oncotype DX检测前，临床医生比GPT-4o更频繁地推荐CT，C1为58%对38%，C2为53%对43%。检测后一致性在C1中增加到93%（0.814 [95% CI，0.76至0.87]，P < .001），在C2中增加到90%（0.741 [95% CI，0.64至0.84]，P < .001）。临床医生在Oncotype DX检测前后治疗建议的一致性在C1和C2中分别为56%和63%，而GPT-4o分别为68%和60%。GPT-4o在预测绝经后患者低基因组风险方面比高基因组风险具有更高的准确性（C1中87%对43%；C2中85%对45%，P < .001），并且在两个队列中预测绝经前患者低风险与中高风险方面也表现出更高准确性（P < .001）。结论：临床医生与GPT-4o在检测前建议上的一致性适中，但检测后有所提高，这强调了多基因检测的重要性以及大型语言模型在临床决策中的潜力。
